key_highlights: ASX weighed down by mining selloff as iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase; oil surges near US$100 on Middle East escalation
AUD sharply weaker amid Australian growth scare; RBA flags rental inflation as key concern
Queensland credit rating downgraded, raising sovereign risk premium for Qld-linked assets
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crash while affordable segment remains resilient; first-home buyer surge
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; mining cap raises accelerate as Canaccord leads capital raises
Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; Santos preservation noted as strategic concession
Woolworths breaches 'Price Freeze' on four staples, reigniting consumer cost-of-living scrutiny
Chinese inflation surge adds external demand uncertainty for commodity exporters

sectors.trend: Sharp selloff; iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, mining stocks tumble to drag ASX lower. Cap raises signal balance-sheet stress. Gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) active but 'gold schmould' sentiment persists.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure on iron ore weakness. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GWN.AX) may see rotation but lack conviction. Cap-raise dilution risk for small/mid-cap miners.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Middle East escalation; Australia softens gas reservation rules. Santos preservation flagged as strategic trade-off. Angola Block 15 discovery (ExxonMobil/ANPG) supports global supply narrative.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SGO.AX benefit from oil spike. Gas policy shift (57) may pressure domestic gas prices but supports export competitiveness. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) gain on Asian demand.

sectors.trend: Growth scare and AUD weakness pressure bank earnings forecasts. RBA focused on rental inflation, suggesting cautious rate path. Queensland downgrade adds sovereign credit risk. Superannuation populism debate (One Nation) creates policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from growth slowdown. Super policy risk (9, 73) could disrupt fund flows. Qld downgrade (1) raises credit cost for Qld-exposed lenders.

sectors.trend: Woolworths breaches Price Freeze on four staples, eroding consumer trust. Cost-of-living pressure persists. Housing correction may boost first-home buyer activity but constrains discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin and reputational risk. Consumer staples remain defensive but pricing power questioned. Housing-linked retail (BHG.AX, IAG.AX) mixed.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. Bathla collapse creates buyer shortfalls. NZ five-year correction still running. RBA rental inflation concern signals tight supply.
sectors.implications: Property trusts (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling capital values. Residential REITs face mixed signals. Construction (WTC.AX, CGW.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyer surge.

sectors.trend: Limited direct ASX impact today. Critical Resources battery tech (46) supports critical minerals theme. No major CSL.AX or tech-specific headlines.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXW.AX relatively insulated from commodity/oil volatility. Battery tech (CR8.AX) in positive testing phase. Defensive rotation likely.

key_themes: Commodity divergence: oil bullish vs iron ore bearish
AUD weakness and Australian growth scare
Housing market bifurcation and correction risk
Energy policy shift: gas reservation relaxation
Mining sector capital raises and balance-sheet stress

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / mining sector contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX, RIO.AX); diversify into gold and energy. Monitor cap-raise dilution.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented and USD-revenue earners. Watch RBA commentary on rental inflation.
Avoid high-end property REITs; favour affordable-segment and industrial REITs. Monitor Bathla-type contagion.
Review Qld-exposed credit and infrastructure plays. Monitor spread widening on Qld bonds.
Energy hedges via WDS.AX, WLE.AX. Monitor geopolitical de-escalation risk for oil pullback.
Monitor political risk; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) could face flow volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy on oil near US$100 and gas policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Middle East escalation supports oil; relaxed gas reservation rules boost export competitiveness. Angola discovery adds supply but near-term demand shock dominates.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining cap-raise opportunities in gold/critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Canaccord-led cap raises (4) create entry points for well-funded explorers. Kuniko and Gateway WA gold systems (47, 48) offer asymmetric upside. Battery tech (CR8.AX) in positive testing.
US$1.9b bid (78) creates near-term catalyst for ASTL.AX. Shipbuilding sector tailwind from global rearmament.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' (24) and mining selloff (2, 44) signal sustained downside. Chinese inflation (52) may signal demand softness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into defensive consumer staples and healthcare
defensive_moves.rationale: Growth scare (32) and AUD weakness favour domestic-revenue, low-beta names. Woolworths pricing issue (34) is idiosyncratic, not sector-wide.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and avoid high-end property REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' (32); high-end housing sees steepest falls (75). Bathla collapse (17) signals construction/property contagion risk.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Iron ore weakness and AUD depreciation weigh on materials and financials. Oil near US$100 provides energy sector support but is geopolitically driven and volatile. RBA's rental inflation focus (42) limits rate-cut expectations, keeping bond yields elevated. Housing correction in high-end segment (75, 51) may accelerate. Net: cautious, range-bound with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook stabilises if iron ore finds a floor and AUD stabilises. Energy policy reform (45, 57) supports LNG exporters structurally. Housing market bifurcation (75) suggests affordable segment resilience. Superannuation policy risk (9, 73) remains a political overhang. Critical minerals and battery tech (46) offer structural growth. Key variable: Chinese demand trajectory post-inflation spike (52).
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision and rental inflation data
Iron ore price floor / Chinese stimulus response
watch_list: RBA cash rate and rental inflation index
